steps.name: probe-and-safe-rules
ac: cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=a11y/noSvgWithoutTitle --only=a11y/useButtonType --only=a11y/noRedundantRoles src/app src/__tests__ src/styles
cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=a11y/noSvgWithoutTitle --only=a11y/useButtonType --only=a11y/noRedundantRoles e2e scripts
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/app
steps.summary: CONTROL 일치: app 5건(svg 장식 4, button 1), e2e·scripts 0건을 aria-hidden/type=button으로 해소; Biome 2.5.9는 --min-files 미지원이라 --max-diagnostics=1000으로 전수 측정.

steps.name: template-and-complexity
ac: cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=style/useTemplate --only=complexity/noUselessSwitchCase --only=complexity/noUselessFragments --only=complexity/useOptionalChain --only=complexity/useLiteralKeys src/app src/__tests__ src/styles

cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=style/useTemplate --only=complexity/noUselessSwitchCase --only=complexity/noUselessFragments --only=complexity/useOptionalChain --only=complexity/useLiteralKeys e2e scripts
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/app
steps.summary: style/useTemplate 20건과 useOptionalChain 1건을 해소했다; CSS allowlist의 선행 공백을 보존했고 sign-in redirect의 undefined·빈 문자열은 계속 /strategies로 귀결된다.

steps.name: aria-and-semantics
ac: cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=a11y/useSemanticElements --only=a11y/useAriaPropsSupportedByRole --only=a11y/noNoninteractiveTabindex --only=a11y/useKeyWithClickEvents src/app src/__tests__ src/styles
cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=a11y/useSemanticElements --only=a11y/useAriaPropsSupportedByRole --only=a11y/noNoninteractiveTabindex --only=a11y/useKeyWithClickEvents e2e scripts
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/app
steps.summary: 복구 동작 액션 줄 2곳을 aria group div에서 fieldset으로 바꾸고 fieldset 기본 여백·최소폭만 Tailwind로 중화했다; Step 3의 noArrayIndexKey 대상은 아직 그대로다.

steps.name: array-index-key
ac: cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=a11y/noSvgWithoutTitle --only=a11y/useButtonType --only=a11y/noRedundantRoles --only=style/useTemplate --only=complexity/noUselessSwitchCase --only=complexity/noUselessFragments --only=complexity/useOptionalChain --only=complexity/useLiteralKeys --only=a11y/useSemanticElements --only=a11y/useAriaPropsSupportedByRole --only=a11y/noNoninteractiveTabindex --only=a11y/useKeyWithClickEvents --only=suspicious/noArrayIndexKey --only=suspicious/noConsole src/app src/__tests__ src/styles

cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome lint --only=a11y/noSvgWithoutTitle --only=a11y/useButtonType --only=a11y/noRedundantRoles --only=style/useTemplate --only=complexity/noUselessSwitchCase --only=complexity/noUselessFragments --only=complexity/useOptionalChain --only=complexity/useLiteralKeys --only=a11y/useSemanticElements --only=a11y/useAriaPropsSupportedByRole --only=a11y/noNoninteractiveTabindex --only=a11y/useKeyWithClickEvents --only=suspicious/noArrayIndexKey e2e scripts
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run src/app
cd apps/web && pnpm exec vitest run
cd apps/web && pnpm exec biome check .
